purpose: Teach: マヤ/デビッド/アンドリュー/トマス/ザック/ゲール/キティ/マンセー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがマヤ文明の遺跡写真集を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he had that collection of photographs of Mayan ruins.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle pause after each phrase, as if touching something precious. Quiet warmth, no urgency. Voice trails slightly — not quite a question, almost thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、デビッド・ボウイの曲を愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when you were young, you did love David Bowie's music so much, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, playful redirection. Knowing smile in the voice. Leans slightly into the 'you' — gently turning the memory-sharing back to him. Affectionate tease wrapped in genuine tenderness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアンドリュー・カーネギーの伝記を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected a biography of Andrew Carnegie.
lines.style: Same wistful reach as before, but a touch slower. Memory settling more deeply. Quiet conviction — these details matter. Very slight trailing-off, inviting her to meet him there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、機関車トーマスのキャラ、つまりトマスをお孫様と楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you used to enjoy Thomas the Tank Engine with our grandson so much, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle counterpoint. Warm but purposeful — she's meeting his memory-tending with her own, keeping the exchange alive. Voice steady, affectionate, no condescension. The 'dear' lands softly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人のザックさんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he corresponded with his friend Zack through letters.
lines.style: Continued soft recall. Each memory surfaces slowly, almost ritually. Very quiet. The name 'Zack' receives a small, fond weight. Voice almost whispered, intimate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、スコットランドのゲール語、つまりゲール文化に詳しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you knew quite a lot about Scottish Gaelic culture, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: She continues the gentle volley. Slightly more animated than before — pride in what he knew, delight in reminding him. Warm, steady voice. 'Gaelic' pronounced with respect. Affectionate close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫様にハローキティのグッズを下さった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he gave our grandson a Hello Kitty gift.
lines.style: Final memory, even quieter than the rest. A small, tender detail — almost vulnerable in its specificity. Barely above a whisper. Long, gentle trailing-off. The voice of someone savoring a last precious thing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、韓国でマンセー、つまり「マンセー!」の意味を学ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you learned what 'Mansae' means — that Korean expression — didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Her final answer, warmest yet. A small laugh underneath. She's delighted to meet him memory for memory. Voice bright but unhurried. Closes with the softest affection in the 'dear' — they've been doing this a long time.
